name: maybe_Ui_Pane_SetFlag4

evidence: Plain set/clear of 0x04 plus child notify via slot +0x18 and func_001A62E4; single caller Ui_DiveManager_Ctor says nothing about the bit's semantics.

name: maybe_Ui_Widget_AttachListNodes
summary: Splices the two optional intrusive list nodes from the static descriptor 0x0072AF1C into the owner's lists at +0x588 and +0x568, setting back-pointers to self. No function pointer is ever called.
evidence: Body only inserts intrusive list nodes via 0x001235A4 and stores back-pointers; descriptor 0x0072AF1C contents unknown; caller is Ui_DiveManager_Ctor.

name: maybe_Ui_Pane_SetEnabledByLookup
summary: Resolves a list-item reference; a resolved row sets bit 1 of the pane flag word, an unresolved one clears it, and the child widget is told whether the pane is now empty.
evidence: Callee Ui_ListItemRef_ResolveRow confirms param 2 is a list-item ref; bit 1 semantics still inferred, so maybe_ kept.

name: maybe_Anim_Clip_BuildLoopFragment

name: maybe_Ui_SakusenWindow_BuildMessageArgsTail
summary: Not a real entry point: it is the second bl plus epilogue inside Ui_SakusenWindow_BuildMessageArgs (0x002A29A8); the symbol exists only so the merge does not create a bogus function.
evidence: Body is halt_baddata(), sole caller is the parent function, assembly shows a mid-function sequence (bl; add sp; pop {pc}).

name: maybe_Field_Actor_SetNutMotion
signature: void maybe_Field_Actor_SetNutMotion(void* self, int useNut, int seekLastFrame)
summary: Selects the actor's 'Nut' motion when useNut is non-zero (state word +0x288 = -1), otherwise the default 'Open' motion (+0x288 = 0), plays it through the animation owner at +0xB8 and, when seekLastFrame is set, jumps to the clip's last frame.
evidence: Inline literal 'Nut' at 0x002B342C and default name pointer *0x007283F8 resolving to 'Open' in the animation-name table; no named caller.

name: maybe_Field_Object2D_AdvanceTouchTransition
summary: Advances the object's touch animation one step (Field_Object2D_RunTouchTransition) and returns 1 while the state byte at *self is not the terminal value 3, i.e. 'still running'.
evidence: Asm: bl 0x423648 then ldrb r0,[r0]; cmp r0,#3; eor r0,r0,#1 - steps touch state machine and returns 'not finished'; no named caller.

name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_QueryState
summary: Refreshes the object's cached interaction record: builds a type-5 record from the attached actor id (or 0xFF) and the object's position through Field_Object2D_CreateTouchEvent, then copies its id, three flag bytes and four coordinates into +0x4D8..+0x4F4 and returns 1.
evidence: Callee Field_Object2D_CreateTouchEvent is confident and names this function; record meaning (touch event vs interaction state) rests on that callee's own inference.

name: maybe_Ui_Window_SelectStateByFlag
summary: Asks Item_HasSpecialRangeItem whether a special flag range is set, requests controller state 3 or 0 accordingly, and commits the request via the controller slot +0x10 when it succeeds.
evidence: Only callee is Item_HasSpecialRangeItem; body drives subComponent35C slots f_14/f_10 with states 0/3; no caller or vtable row identifies the concrete window class.

name: maybe_Ui_JackpotScreen_UpdatePayout
signature: void maybe_Ui_JackpotScreen_UpdatePayout(void* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int b)
summary: Per-frame payout step of the jackpot screen: waits on the cue and roulette window animations, then switches the step function to the next jackpot callback row.
evidence: Callees include maybe_Ui_JackpotScreen_UpdateIntro and the jackpot callback table g_uiJackpotScreenCallbacks; state ids 4/5/6/7 remain unexplained.

name: Ui_JackpotScreen_UpdateStopTransition
summary: Advances the jackpot screen's stop transition, starts the cue once the counter reaches 0x37, and on transition completion commits the pending control and installs the next callback step.
evidence: Calls Ui_Transition_Start/Ui_Cue_Start/Ui_Screen_CommitPendingControl and writes g_uiJackpotScreenCallbacks step fields; class context is the jackpot screen block.

name: maybe_Ui_Object_DeleteDtor48
summary: Generic deleting destructor: calls the object's virtual destructor then frees the 0x48-byte block with the sized free helper.
evidence: Body is only virtual dtor call plus func_00147AEC(self,0x48); no caller or vtable row identifies the owner class.

name: maybe_Ui_ListState_Reset
summary: Resets the UI manager's list/scroll state: clears counters and flag bytes, zero-fills the tail, allocates the 0x1820-byte table, restores cursor 0x5E, sentinel 0xFF and page count 6, and locks the state mutex.
evidence: Sole caller maybe_Ui_Menu_SetModeState passes the UI manager singleton; the 0x5E/0xFF/6 constants and mutex lock support a list-state reset but no named callee confirms it.

name: maybe_Ui_Sequence_AdvanceTimedStep
signature: unsigned int maybe_Ui_Sequence_AdvanceTimedStep(void* self, int* ctx)
summary: Timed sequence step: increments the frame counter, plays SEs at frames 0 and 0x49, and reports done when the sub-object has no value or its float equals the completion constant.
evidence: Only named callee is Sound_PlaySeCached; frame counter plus two SE cues and a float completion test, but no caller identifies the owning sequence.

name: maybe_Anim_Owner_DeletingDtor
summary: Deleting destructor of an object owning an animation instance: stores the vtable, destroys the embedded Anim_Instance at +0xFC and the 0x002650xx module, then frees the object.
evidence: Calls Anim_Instance_Dtor and func_002650C4 then operator delete; no vtable row or caller names the concrete class.

name: maybe_Battle_Effect_SetLinkRecord
summary: Sets the effect link kind, clears the resolved/active flags, resolves the id through the record lookup and copies the record's two u16 ids into the link fields.
evidence: Callers are Field_Gimmick_UpdateEffectLink and maybe_Battle_Effect_UpdateLinkSegments; callee is the record resolver 0x0018C1B8, but the copied ids' meaning is inferred.

name: Ui_Object_SetLayoutId
summary: Stores a layout/record id at +0x53, clears the resolved flags at +0x54/+0x55, and copies the resolved record's two u16 fields into +0x4C/+0x4E.
evidence: Only caller is confident Ui_ApplyScaleToChildren (0x003CAD78) passing the parent's record id from virtual +0x7C; body is a pure setter with record lookup via 0x0018C184.

name: Battle_ActionSequence_ReapplyLayout
summary: Clears the selected row and word at +0xDE18, re-applies the screen scale to children, then re-reads the active child's record id and rebuilds the resource dependency tree when valid.
evidence: Vtable row 0x00763848 sits in the Battle_ActionSequence table between Dtor and UpdateTurn; calls Ui_ApplyScaleToChildren and maybe_Resource_BuildDependencyTree.

name: maybe_Ui_Window_ReapplyScaleAndClearFlag
summary: Shared UI-window reset template: clears the selected row, re-applies the screen scale, and clears the flag word at +0x72C of the object returned by virtual +0x3C when the +0x48 object's +0x10 byte is set.
evidence: Body identical to 0x004F7F7C/0x00595098/0x005A4D40; vtable row 0x0077A648 holds a maybe_ Text_MessageWindow dtor, so class prefix is not proven; only callee is Ui_ApplyScaleToChildren.

name: Battle_Action_RestoreIdleByHpWhenAnimEnds
summary: When the model at self+0x28 reports its current animation reached the end, restores the actor's post-action idle posture from HP percentage.
evidence: 0x0066A2BC tests model->f_160 and 0x00633F68 compares animation frame floats; tail call is confident Battle_Action_RestoreActorIdleByHp (0x0038AB68).
